{{2009–10 ACC men's basketball standings}}
The '''2009–10 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Virginia]] during the [[2009–10 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by first-year head coach Tony Bennett, and played their home games at [[John Paul Jones Arena]] as members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]].

==Last season==
The [[2008–09 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Cavaliers]] fell to 10–18, with a conference record of 4–12. This was their worst conference record since [[Pete Gillen]]'s final season in 2004–05, and the worst overall record for Virginia in four decades. At the conclusion of the season, head coach [[Dave Leitao]] resigned.<ref name="leitao">{{cite web |url=http://www.virginiasports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/031609aaa.html |title=Dave Leitao Resigns As UVa's Head Men's Basketball Coach |publisher=VirginiaSports.com |date=31 March 2009 |accessdate=9 December 2014}}</ref> On April 1, 2009, [[Washington State Cougars men's basketball|Washington State]] head coach [[Tony Bennett (basketball, born 1969)|Tony Bennett]] was announced as his replacement.<ref name="BennettHired">{{cite news |url=https://www.readthehook.net/71982/heeeres-tony-bennett-makes-debut-uva-coach |title=Heeere's Tony: Bennett makes debut as UVA coach |publisher=[[The Hook (newspaper)|The Hook]] |first=Lindsay |last=Barnes III |date=1 April 2009 |access-date=2022-12-19}}</ref>
